audioExport.renderCancelNote: Cancel prevents saving. Audio rendering already in progress may continue using CPU until it finishes.

sfx.subtitle: Advanced Sound Effect Synthesizer
sfx.shortcuts: Shortcuts: A/B (slots) · 1-8,Q,W,E,R,T,Y,U (presets) · Space (play) · L (loop) · M (mutate) · Ctrl+Z (undo)

waveform.title: Waveform Display
waveform.description: Time-domain shape of the audio signal. Y-axis is amplitude (-1 to 1), X-axis is time.

spectrum.title: Frequency Spectrum
spectrum.description: Shows which frequencies are present. Taller bars = more prominent frequency. Logarithmic scale.

amplitude.title: Signal Level
amplitude.description: RMS (average loudness) and Peak level in dB. Red peak = clipping.

envelope.title: Volume Envelope
envelope.description: Overall volume shape from start to finish, shaped by Attack, Sustain, and Decay.

p_freq_ramp.title: Frequency Slide
p_freq_ramp.description: Pitch slides up (+) or down (-) over time.

p_env_attack.title: Attack
p_env_attack.description: How quickly the sound fades in.

p_env_sustain.title: Sustain
p_env_sustain.description: How long the sound holds at full volume.

p_env_punch.title: Punch
p_env_punch.description: Extra burst of volume at the start of sustain.

p_env_decay.title: Decay
p_env_decay.description: How quickly the sound fades out.

p_arp_mod.title: Arpeggio Mod
p_arp_mod.description: Pitch jump amount for arpeggio effect.

p_lpf_freq.title: Low-pass Filter
p_lpf_freq.description: Cuts high frequencies. Lower = darker sound.

p_hpf_freq.title: High-pass Filter
p_hpf_freq.description: Cuts low frequencies. Higher = thinner sound.

voice.loadFile: Drop audio file here or click to browse
voice.dropAudio: Drop audio file or click to upload
voice.subtitle: Voice Synthesis & Real-time Processing

timeline.name: Name
timeline.mixerHelp: Solo temporarily overrides saved mute states; Clear solos restores them. Solo also affects export. The green dot marks an audible track. Listen only changes the saved mix.
timeline.startHelp: Import a recording, or select several aligned microphone files to create separate tracks. You can also open a saved project.

common.dropAudio: Drop audio file here or click to browse

tts.title: Text to Speech
tts.systemVoiceHint: Rendered on this device with the system voices; nothing is uploaded. Download higher-quality voices in Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices.

about.title: About
about.description: Cross-platform audio workstation combining sound synthesis, voice effects processing, and a timeline waveform editor. Built with Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript + Rust.

licenses.title: Third-Party Licenses
licenses.intro: CrispAudio is built with the following open-source packages.

interview.invalidSession: Not a supported CrispAudio sync session
interview.replace: Import as a new project? Save your current project first if needed. You can undo this import in this session.
interview.previewFailed: Video preview could not be loaded. Check that the original video still exists and its codec is supported.
interview.reviewHelp: Offset is the recorder time corresponding to video time zero. Positive values trim the beginning of the recording. Weak matches require manual review and confirmation. Select an output folder to keep the aligned tracks. Only the first microphone will play initially; use solo/mute to compare.
interview.confirmOffset: I reviewed and confirmed this offset
interview.import: Align and import as new project
interview.matchLevels: Match listening levels with constant gain (no denoising or compression)
interview.title: Media tools
interview.steps: 1 Choose files → 2 Check sync → 3 Edit & export
interview.editHelp: Choose a microphone, edit the audio, then export with the original picture.
interview.listenHelp: Compare microphones. These buttons change the active mix for the whole timeline.
interview.setupHelp: Choose a video with camera audio. External recordings are optional; with recordings, review synchronization before import. Import creates a new project.
interview.mobileHelp: Automatic video sync and MP4 export currently require the desktop app with FFmpeg. On iPhone/iPad, import aligned WAVs from Files, edit their audio on the timeline, and export the mix. Desktop linked projects contain Mac file paths and cannot be transferred directly.

alignment.title: Check alignment
alignment.help: Overlay two microphones on the same time scale. Look for matching speech starts and transients; check several positions for drift.
alignment.chart: Normalized audio envelopes on a shared timeline
alignment.note: Each envelope is normalized within this window, before gain, fades and effects. Different microphones can have different shapes; this view alone does not prove synchronization. No offsets are changed.

video.noPicture: No video clip here · black output
video.seek: Seek video on the shared timeline
video.rangeHelp: The range trims edited picture and mixed audio together at export. Edited picture is re-encoded. Only a completely untouched full-length source keeps its original compressed picture. Audio clip positions are independent of picture edits.
video.invalidRange: Enter a valid range: 0 ≤ in < out ≤ recording duration.

editor.panHelp: Trackpad sideways · Shift+wheel · Ctrl/Cmd+wheel to zoom
editor.newHelp: Save the current arrangement first if you want to keep it. Clear starts an empty audio timeline. You can also undo this reset.
editor.trackFilesHelp: Save selected tracks, clips, effects and embedded audio as a reusable project. Load tracks adds these lanes at their saved positions without replacing the current project.
editor.muteOverridden: Saved mute is temporarily overridden by Solo

sync.title: Auto-sync tracks
sync.desktop: Track synchronization requires the desktop app.
sync.help: Choose a reference and at least one other track containing the same recording. Analysis uses the current clip positions before mix gain/effects. Review the result before applying.
sync.offsetOnly: Apply offsets moves clips only; it does not correct clock drift. Positive offsets move the target earlier. Audio before time zero is trimmed. For long recordings with drift, use Add video + recordings to render corrected source files.
sync.changed: The arrangement changed during analysis. Analyze it again.

editing.precisionHelp: Arrow keys: 1 ms; Shift: 100 ms; Alt: 1 sample. Alt-drag bypasses snapping. Exact positions can be entered above.
editing.returnVoice: Apply to original clip and return
editing.voiceTarget: Editing a timeline clip. Send back to replace its source; Undo in Timeline restores it.
editing.invalidVideo: Invalid timing: keep source bounds, fades within the clip, and overlaps equal to the incoming transition.
editing.videoHelp: Picture edits use the project frame rate. Linked timing edits also affect audio. Existing linked overlaps can change transition style; unlink before changing camera or overlap length. Enter commits numeric edits; Escape cancels.
editing.needPrevious: A transition needs a preceding clip. Use Fade in on the first clip.
editing.transitionTiming: Changing the style of an existing overlap preserves its timing. Creating an overlap or changing its length moves an unlinked picture clip; audio stays in place. Unlink before removing a linked overlap. Gaps show black.
editing.advancedTransitions: Match cut: align matching frames and use Cut. Page peel uses a shaded, mirrored fold; it is not a 3D page simulation.
editing.approximatePreview: Approximate effect preview; export uses FFmpeg
editing.overviewHelp: Drag to browse the timeline; drag the red cursor to seek

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.mediaHelp: Add sources here and insert them at the playhead. New cameras append to the arrangement. Camera audio can stay linked to picture.
workspace.insertTrack: Insert audio on a new track
workspace.overlap: Move the playhead to a gap before inserting picture.
workspace.linkHelp: Linked picture and audio move, trim, split and delete together. Unlink for independent edits. Shift-select clips to create a link.
workspace.selectClip: Select a clip to inspect it.
workspace.rippleHelp: Removes this time interval from every track, shifts later clips, markers and captions. Undo restores it. Remove picture transitions first.
workspace.micHelp: Compare two aligned microphones. Suggestions use relative signal levels, not speaker recognition. Review each section. Applying replaces their gain automation and mutes other tracks.
workspace.pointHelp: Add a point at the playhead. The yellow line shows gain automation; preview and export interpolate between points.
workspace.textHelp: Import timed SRT, VTT or JSON segments from CrisperWeaver. Click a passage to seek and select its interval. Edit captions or remove a passage across all tracks.
workspace.loudnessHelp: Targets −16 LUFS with a −1 dB peak ceiling using measured EBU R128 loudness. This changes track gain; effects and automation are excluded from the measurement.
workspace.relinkHelp: The project references a missing file. Locate its replacement to continue loading.
workspace.driftHelp: Drift correction creates new audio sources; originals remain available for Undo. Linked picture supports offsets only.
workspace.denoiseHelp: Conservative FFT noise reduction and rumble filtering. Creates a new source; Undo restores the original. Review for speech artifacts.
workspace.oneSource: Select a track using one audio source.
workspace.linkedOnly: Save or reimport this source as a linked audio file first.
workspace.durationChanged: Cleanup changed the source duration; original audio retained.

usability.contextHelp: Help mode: hover, focus or tap a highlighted control.
usability.help_snap: Clips snap to nearby edges while dragging. Alt temporarily disables snapping; this button toggles it.
usability.help_waveform: Highlighted: each waveform is normalized for readability. Off: compare relative levels. This never changes gain, playback or export.
usability.help_split: Cuts at the red playhead. Scissors splits selected clips; Layers splits all clips crossing that position. Linked picture and sound stay together. Undo restores the cut.
usability.help_inspector: Select a clip, then open its settings to edit timing, fades and picture transitions. Linked timing edits affect its audio/video partner too.
usability.help_mixer: Adjust each track’s Mute, Solo, volume and fades. These settings affect playback and export. Compact rows keep these controls available here.
usability.help_nudge: Left/right moves the selected clips by the chosen step. Linked clips move together. With no selection, the buttons seek instead.
usability.help_play: Play/Pause controls playback. Stop returns to the beginning. The skip buttons jump to the start or end. POS lets you enter an exact position.
usability.help_loop: Repeats the whole arrangement. Highlighted means loop is enabled.
usability.help_mute: Silences this track. Solo temporarily overrides saved mute states; clearing solos restores them. Mute affects export too.
usability.help_solo: Hear soloed tracks while other tracks stay silent. Solo overrides mute temporarily. Clear solos to restore the saved mix. Solo affects export too.
usability.help_sync: Choose a camera recording and external microphone files, analyze their offsets, then review and import the aligned tracks. Desktop media tools require FFmpeg.
usability.help_files: New clears the arrangement after confirmation. Open loads a saved project; Save keeps tracks, clips and timing. Keep linked media files available beside your project.
usability.fullscreenFallback: Native fullscreen is unavailable; the viewer fills this window.
usability.importDestinationHelp: Choose a destination. New tracks start together at the playhead; files imported into one track are placed consecutively.
usability.newTrackEach: A new track for each file
usability.importProjectChanged: The project changed during import. Import again into the new arrangement.
usability.importTrackMissing: The destination track was removed during import.
usability.help_move: On touch, selection mode lets you select clips and swipe to browse. Enable the hand button to move clips or drag their edges to trim. With a mouse, drag directly. Alt temporarily disables snapping.
usability.help_navigation: Video, audio and ruler share one time scale. Shift+wheel or sideways trackpad motion scrolls; Ctrl/Cmd+wheel zooms. Fit all resets the view. Drag the blue overview window to browse or its red cursor to seek.
usability.help_reorder: Drag the six-dot handle onto another audio track header. Use its arrow keys or the up/down buttons for precise ordering. Reordering changes display order, not timing or sound. Hold near the top or bottom edge to scroll to other tracks; Escape cancels a drag. You can drop over a waveform as well as a header.
usability.help_overlap: Audio clips mix when they overlap. Shift-select two partially overlapping clips and use Crossfade selected audio overlap to add S-curve fades. Drag two video clips into a partial overlap to create a cross dissolve; Clip settings changes its transition. Three simultaneous video clips or complete containment are not supported on this composition lane.
usability.help_time: Click POS or DUR and enter seconds or mm:ss.mmm; Enter commits, Escape cancels. Duration adds empty space after your clips and cannot trim existing content. Audio export includes this silent tail.
usability.help_import: Choose an existing destination track or a new track for each file. Reading, decoding and waveform preparation are shown separately and can be cancelled. Desktop file links are retained for efficient saves. Large compressed recordings still need decoding.
usability.help_height: The height control affects both video and audio, from 24 to 640 pixels. Compact audio rows hide mixer controls; open the mixer to change Mute, Solo or gain. A small status dot still shows whether a compact track is audible.
usability.help_remove: Trash in a track header removes that lane. Removing video keeps its audio and unlinks it. The toolbar trash removes selected clips, including linked audio/video partners. Undo restores either action.
usability.help_fullscreen: Expand video opens a viewport-filling viewer and requests native fullscreen where available. Playback and frame-step controls stay visible. Escape or the shrink button closes it. In the expanded viewer, Left/Right steps frames and Space toggles playback. Tab stays among viewer controls; timeline editing shortcuts are isolated.
usability.help_fades: Audio uses the chosen curve; video fades linearly to/from black. Durations are limited to each clip length.

analysis.spectrumHelp: Relative FFT spectrum of a representative loud window; not a calibrated level meter.

rack.orderHelp: Effects run from top to bottom. Changes stop playback; play again to audition.

fades.title: Fade selected clips
fades.videoHelp: Audio uses the chosen curve; video fades linearly to/from black. Durations are limited to each clip length.

videoColor.title: Colour correction
videoColor.applySelected: Apply colour to selected picture clips
videoColor.help: Applied before fades and transitions. Preview and export use the same settings; colour management and encoding may cause small visual differences.

videoTransform.title: Picture orientation
videoTransform.copy: Apply orientation to selected picture clips
videoTransform.help: Fits inside the existing picture frame. Audio and timing stay unchanged.
